🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 19, 2026

Sun, in Scorpio, holds a trine to Moon, in Pisces. The same water temperament, twice over: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Venus in Libra stands opposite, and what you value is quoted back. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Pisces, Moon hands you an opening. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Pisces, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Mutable air: keeping options is the expense. Two weeks ago Mercury was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Pisces. From Scorpio, Sun makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. Mercury squares you from Scorpio, and the cost objects. Fixed fire pays to hold on. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. From Pisces, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Earth that changes shape, charged for each shape. Mercury went direct a week ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Mars sextiles you from Leo: a door left ajar. Air that starts things, started cheaply. Venus left Scorpio four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. Four weeks, 14° of Mars: slight, and real.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Moon in Pisces presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Mutable fire keeps two accounts open and pays both. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Sun in Scorpio leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Sun squares you from Scorpio, and something has to give way. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. The hold Mars had four weeks ago is not there any more.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Mutable water: both answers turn out to be one answer. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.
